description: SPENDS credits: makes ONE new GPT Image picture directly from your scene prompt and optional reviewed reference photos, without Soclo AI planning. Quote first with soclo_image_quote, then pass the quoted expectedCredits (including an owner-exempt 0), pricingVersion and ownerApprovedPrice:true only after the owner approves the price quoted first. Photo editing, background removal and upscaling use their separately named tools. Every generated picture is saved durably to the owner’s Soclo Library: the tool returns the owner Library assetId and a resultUrl link, never raw image bytes — inspect and reuse it from the Library. Premium GPT image editing is the default; Standard is available if the owner chooses it. Supply and retain a UUID clientRequestId BEFORE calling. A lost result or unknown charge must be reconciled with soclo_image_recover, never automatically retried. A 202 image_result_pending answer means the charge may already have happened: re-send this SAME request id to collect the saved picture, and never start a second paid request for it. An exact replay returns the same Library asset with no second charge — it was not free the first time. Use it for each host-authored opening still. It does not attach the image to a plan or publish it. For attached photos, supply only the exact selected, reviewed private evidence locators in order from soclo_photo_reference_prepare or soclo_brand_photo_reference. The tool checks the live v1 capability and refuses if the sealed reference receipt is missing; it never falls back to text-only generation.

clientRequestId.description: Required before generate: one stable UUID per picture purchase. Required before frames; recover and frames_result read the original UUID without a new render. Never retry an unknown outcome automatically or mint a replacement ID to bypass a duplicate refusal.

expectedCredits.description: Required: use the exact authenticated native quote, including zero only when quoted for the owner-exempt account. Frames uses its own existing quote.

imageUrls.description: For generate: up to ten distinct selected, reviewed HTTPS private evidence locators, in intended order. Ordinary public Library URLs cannot prove reference use.

model.description: GPT Image for a new picture.

ownerApprovedPrice.description: Required true for generate only after the account owner has seen the tier price and approved this single picture purchase. A retry spend needs a new yes.

pictureTier.description: For generate: premium is the default; use standard only if the owner chooses it. Read the authenticated native quote for the exact account price.

pricingVersion.description: From the authenticated native quote for this picture or enhancement; frames uses its own quote.

prompt.description: Required for generate: the host-authored scene text, sent directly to image generation.

name: soclo_image_generate
title: Make one picture
